description: Ministry of Public Administration, Management and Law and Order - Notify the 4th Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service (published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1842/02 of 23.12.2013 for open written competitive examination)
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains specifically to public service recruitment matters, detailing the syllabus for the open written competitive examination for recruitment to Grade III of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and focuses on administrative procedures for public sector hiring, falling clearly under Public Service Gazettes.
